UK Dashboard英国 Dashboard

A chart-and-data-first UK macro page aligned to the GS Understanding UK Economic Statistics framework. The page prioritises reproducible public series from native ONS and Bank of England endpoints, while keeping FRED/OECD/BIS/IMF mirrors for broader public-data coverage and preserving vendor-controlled GS/PMI/CBI/RICS items as explicit data gaps.一个以图表和数据为核心的英国宏观页面，结构对齐GS Understanding UK Economic Statistics 框架。页面优先使用ONS与Bank of England原生可复跑公开接口，同时保留FRED/OECD/BIS/IMF镜像作为更广覆盖的公开数据骨架；GS、PMI、CBI、RICS等供应商控制指标则明确列为数据缺口。

Data policy: no fabricated proxies. FRED remains the durable public backbone, while release-sensitive UK series prefer native ONS time-series JSON and Bank of England IADB CSV endpoints when validated. 数据原则：不制造假proxy。FRED继续作为稳定公开骨架；对发布时效更敏感的英国序列，在验证后优先使用ONS time-series JSON与Bank of England IADB CSV原生接口。

National Accounts & GDP Tracking国民账户与GDP跟踪

The GS UK guide stresses that early GDP releases are heavily revised. Use official GDP, demand components, and real-time trackers together rather than treating first GDP as the final word.GS英国统计指南强调，早期GDP发布会经历较大修订。应把官方GDP、需求分项与实时跟踪指标结合使用，而不是把初值视为最终答案。
